events.body:
With https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-api/-/merge_requests/15 merged, the D1 database is currently behind the migration files. Please apply the latest migrations to remote D1 instances so that the new schema fields are available.

`npx wrangler d1 migrations apply blt-api --remote`

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-api/-/issues/15 (opened by @Nachiket_R on 2026-08-18).

**Discussion summary**

- The monorepo deploy does not apply D1 migrations, so this stays a manual step: `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply blt-api --remote` from `blt-api/`.
events.title: blt-api: Pending Migration
